about_the_game:
"This place it feels wrong"

“Screaming In The Basement” is a psychological thriller from the first person, unfolding through tense silence and detailed sound design that builds a growing sense of unease. Inspired by P.T.

Average time to complete: 200 minutes

WARNING:

Epileptic seizures associated with increased sensitivity to light are Possible. Some people may experience seizures when exposed to flashes of light and flashing images that appear in a video game. People who have not previously experienced such attacks may not be aware of their illness. A reasonable restriction of the game audience is recommended.

Mike is the main character, a journalist driven by a thirst for uncovering deep, hidden truths. He gains access to an apartment where, according to locals, restless souls are said to haunt the place. This is a fact that still needs to be confirmed, tied to a terrible incident. A family consisting of a father, mother, and daughter once lived in the apartment and were killed by someone whose identity remains unknown.

In 1990, a family bought a house in Russia from Robert. After hearing strange noises from the basement and rumors of a curse, they left and moved to New York, they rented apartment from Norman Harold. Sarah often heard strange whispers and scratching sounds coming from below. Sometimes, it sounded like someone was calling her name. She tried to tell her parents, but they dismissed her fears, saying it was just the old house settling.

What awaits you:

  • Walking Simulator – A narrative-driven experience focused on exploration and atmosphere.

  • Uncover the Truth – Investigate supernatural rumors and piece together a disturbing history.

  • Multiple Endings – The game has three different endings, and each one tells a unique story based on your choices. Uncover the truth or lose yourself.

  • Realistic Gameplay – Immersive, grounded mechanics that mirror real-life interactions.

  • Isolation – You’re completely alone, with no one to help, heightening your vulnerability and fear.

  • Environmental Shifts – Explore detailed rooms and witness subtle, unsettling changes as you progress.

  • Immersive Sound Design – Natural ambient sounds draw you deeper into a world of growing tension and madness.

  • Paranormal Activity: Objects move and environments change mysteriously.

  • Explore at your own pace – Discover hidden secrets, notes, and clues that could unravel the mystery.

  • Player-Driven Narrative – The story unfolds through your actions, recordings, and the decisions you make.

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains scenes of violence that may negatively affect the viewer’s psychological state. Some content may be inappropriate for certain age groups. It is advised to apply suitable age restrictions for the intended audience.

short_description: Inspired by P.T., a journalist named Mike investigates a tragic family murder linked to a cursed apartment in New York. Unsettling mysteries surround a deadly incident from 1991, and while restless souls are said to haunt the place, this remains unconfirmed.
